WHERE rel.releaseName IN ['Rel-18'] AND spec.specRelease = rel.releaseName AND disposition.evidenceStatus = 'source_verified' AND disposition.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '"scope": "whole_target"'
WITH DISTINCT pack, cr, rel, clause, spec, toInteger(replace(pack.tsgMeeting, 'RAN#', '')) AS currentMeeting
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  MATCH (earlier:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(clause), (earlier)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel), (earlier)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(earlierPack:CRPack)
  WHERE toInteger(replace(earlierPack.tsgMeeting, 'RAN#', '')) < currentMeeting
}
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS document, spec.specNumber AS specification, clause.sectionNumber AS clause
